bundle.shortDescription: Control panel for your AI coding agents
bundle.longDescription: Ahabby finds the AI coding agents installed on your machine (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode, Cursor, ...) and gives you one place to inspect their versions, configs, skills and MCP servers.
